hooks.logic:
Count up "currentTurn".
Let part be part 1 of the acting enemy.
If condition flag v is up this frame, then
  Reset the count "currentTurn".
  Choose state 11 next and stop.
If the HP fraction of part is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_explosion" in the battle settings of the group of part, then choose state 14 next and stop.
If part is ready to act, then
  If the count "currentTurn" is at least the numeric entry "number_of_turns_to_phase_change" in the battle settings of the group of part and the HP fraction of part is more than the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_explosion" in the battle settings of the group of part, then
    Let ability be the id of the move labelled "elixir" on part.
    Part uses ability with its cast time followed by [{abilityId: ability}, {abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{builtin: "RECOVER", recover: {recoverNo: [1]}}], [{deformTag: "deformation_02", filteringDeformPosArray: [1]}], [{builtin: "CHANGE_PARAM", paramSuffixNo: "1"}], [{builtin: "RESET_CAST_ABILITY"}]]}}].
  Otherwise, part picks and uses a smart-weighted move.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let v2 be the first x in arg where the value "no" of x is 1.
If the current state is 17, then return true.
If the current state is 15, then
  Let v3 be false.
  For each x in arg
    Let part be part (the value "no" of x) of the enemy.
    Let lastAbility be the last move of part.
    If lastAbility and the value "abilityId" of lastAbility is the id of the move labelled "suicide_bomb" on part, then set v3 to true.
  If v3, then return true.
  Otherwise
    Change state to 16.
    Return false.
Return the current state is not 14 and (not (not v2 or the current state is 13 or the current state is 12) and (change state to 13, then false)).
